summary: 12-point production readiness features verified end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py against the live preview backend — Caste CRUD (incl. super-admin tenant-isolation), Religion CRUD, Family Linking (pending invitation + list outgoing/incoming + cancel), Karyakarta CRUD + bulk-import + celebrations (/dashboard/karyakarta-celebrations returns birthdays{today,upcoming}+anniversaries{today,upcoming}), Visit Visibility (internal visit does NOT create a Notification; public does; citizen /visits excludes internal; staff includes internal), Super Admin Subscriptions list/edit/PUT (5000 monthly 2026-08-01 persisted; non-super gets 403), Pending karyakarta auto-promotion on citizen register (pending row moves to linked; V1 user extra_roles gets 'karyakarta' — verified via re-fetch after register). Frontend: Playwright automation confirmed — Citizen Home shows [data-testid=family-link-btn] which opens [data-testid=family-link-dialog] with relationship/mobile/name fields + Send; Karyakartas admin page lists linked+pending with 'Add Karyakarta' (opens dialog) and 'Bulk Import CSV' (opens dialog with Download template link); Taxonomy page shows Caste + Religion panels; Visits composer has Visibility select (Public / Internal only); Staff Dashboard has [data-testid=karyakarta-celebrations] element on the VK tenant; Super Admin /app/subscriptions renders all client portals with active status pills, Edit dialog opens with billing_cycle select, agreed_amount ₹ and next_renewal_date fields (persisted value ₹5000 monthly 2026-08-01 visible on 'gokul' row after PUT).

minor.issue: The 'user' object returned in the register response is snapshotted BEFORE the pending-karyakarta promotion runs, so extra_roles=[] in the immediate response even though the DB row is correctly updated (verified by re-fetching via verify-otp). Consider re-reading the user row from Mongo after the promotion block before building the response.

issues: Uses browser's native HTML5 date input (mm/dd/yyyy) for 'Service start date' and 'Next renewal date' instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker — inconsistent with other date pickers used in the app.

action_items: (Low) Refetch the citizen user row after the pending-karyakarta promotion block in citizen_register (server.py ~830) so the immediate register response reflects extra_roles=['karyakarta'] for the frontend without a second call.
(Low) Replace the native HTML5 date input in SuperSubscriptions.jsx Edit dialog with the shadcn DatePicker for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py caste/religion delete does not check role beyond require_roles('admin') — good; tenant_filter applied on delete.

server.py /api/karyakartas/bulk-import loops per-row calling _create_or_link_karyakarta which does its own DB round-trips; fine for small imports but not scalable for CSVs >~500 rows. Consider batching or a bulk_write.

server.py /api/visits POST correctly guards notification creation with `if v.status == 'Published' and v.visibility != 'internal'` (line ~1281) and citizen list filter `q['visibility'] = {'$ne': 'internal'}` (line ~1334). Verified end-to-end.

server.py /api/admin/subscriptions PUT is idempotent, updates only provided fields (`{k: v for k, v in payload.model_dump().items() if v is not None}`), stamps updated_at, returns fresh doc without _id.
